description: Defines the 'Order' entity class in the admin web layer, encapsulating order-related information and relationships such as status, delivery, and billing.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Entity class representing an Order with properties like ID, status list, date, related order details, delivery, and billing information.

methods.name: getDatePurchased
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the order was purchased.

methods.name: setDatePurchased
methods.description: Sets the date when the order was purchased.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier of the order.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the order.

methods.name: getOrderHistoryComment
methods.description: Retrieves the comment related to order history.

methods.name: setOrderHistoryComment
methods.description: Sets the comment related to order history.

methods.name: getOrderStatusList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of order statuses.

methods.name: setOrderStatusList
methods.description: Sets the list of order statuses.
